task.description: REWORK ITERATION 1 (implementation): re-implement ONLY insert_review/2 in lib/letflow/definitions/promotion_review_store.ex per the revised, re-validated design (lib/letflow/design/promotion_review_state_machine.md sec 2.3/2.8). The bug: your prior implementation set attrs.tenant_id from plan.target_tenant_id (caller-supplied), which SECURITY-REVIEWER FAILed as a cross-tenant write risk (BLOCKER, INV-1). The revised design now requires deriving tenant_id via Letflow.TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name(prefix) instead -- read the design's revised sec 2.3 in full for the exact new algorithm step, and read tenant_id_for_schema_name/1's real implementation at lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex:100-115 directly. Also update insert_review_error()'s @type: drop :invalid_tenant_id, add :invalid_schema_name (the function's real error atom now that plan.target_tenant_id is no longer read for this purpose). Do NOT touch approve_review/4, reject_review/3, mark_review_applied/2, mark_review_failed/2, supersede_review/3, or promotion.ex's promote_definition/3 -- SECURITY-REVIEWER and CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR both independently confirmed those are unaffected (they never touch tenant_id).
acceptance_criteria: insert_review/2 derives tenant_id from opts[:prefix] via TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name/1, never from plan.target_tenant_id
MIX_TEST_PARTITION=2 mix test still passes (536/536 baseline, no regressions)
No other function in either file changed
